programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP23 Auntie Ballistic [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 -EP26 Shot Through the Heart [English Dub]
